text: Fill in the missing term in each sentence about thiamine and niacin deficiency.
questions: Thiamine pyrophosphate is the coenzyme of pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and the pentose phosphate pathway enzyme *transketolase:This enzyme's activity in red cells is the functional test for thiamine status.*.

Eating *polished:Parboiling before milling drives thiamine into the grain and protects it.* rice is the classic Indian cause of thiamine deficiency because milling removes the bran where thiamine is concentrated.
Wet *beriberi:The other form of this condition is a symmetrical peripheral neuropathy with foot drop.* presents as high-output cardiac failure with peripheral oedema from vasodilatation.
Pellagra presents with the classic triad of dermatitis, diarrhoea and *dementia*.
The body can synthesise some niacin from the amino acid *tryptophan:Maize protein is poor in tryptophan, which is why maize-based diets cause pellagra.*.

overallFeedback.feedback: Thiamine pyrophosphate is needed by pyruvate dehydrogenase and alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase to enter and complete the TCA cycle, so thiamine deficiency starves the brain and heart of ATP; pellagra is dermatitis, diarrhoea and dementia (the three Ds, leading to the fourth, death). Niacin forms NAD+ for the same oxidative pathways; the body can also make niacin from tryptophan at a ratio of roughly 60 mg tryptophan to 1 mg niacin, and tryptophan-poor diets (such as maize) cause pellagra because this endogenous synthesis is insufficient.
